Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | | | | | If you bank with any of these 63 financial institutions, your money could be on the chopping block. **NO KINGS THIS SATURDAY** No Kings is this Saturday at Elmwood Park, at the corner of Jefferson and Elm, from Noon to 1:30pm. When our families are under attack and costs are pushing people to the brink, silence is not an option. We will defend ourselves and our communities against this administration's unjust and cruel acts of violence. America does not belong to strongmen, greedy billionaires, or those who rule through fear. It belongs to us, the people.
---
**CONCERNING ECONOMY AND JOBS REPORT** With jobs disappearing and inflation hitting record highs, people are being crushed by an economy they can't afford to survive in. Especially as we are spending $1 billion per day on a war that is just driving up gas prices exponentially. The Trump administration's policies are hammering young people trying to enter the workforce and abandoning those already pushed out of work by this economic failure. This survey makes it clear: we're barreling toward another recession.

| Friend, For 41 days, the Department of Homeland Security has been shut down because of partisan politics in Washington. And while the left plays political games, the men and women who protect our country are working without pay. **It’s unacceptable and dangerous.** TSA agents showing up before dawn.
Border Patrol agents standing watch at our southern border.
Cybersecurity professionals are defending our infrastructure.
The Coast Guard protecting our waters.
FEMA personnel ready to respond to disasters. They are showing up every day and doing their jobs. **Washington Democrats are not.** As a result of this political theater:
* DHS employees have missed a full paycheck
* TSA callouts are five times higher than normal
* More than 300 TSA agents have already quit
* Security lines are getting longer nationwide
* Operations are strained, and national security risks are increasing

This should not be a partisan issue. **Paying the people who protect our country should be the __bare minimum__ expectation of a functioning government.** That’s why I introduced the [Pay Our Homeland Defenders Act ](https://juanciscomani.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4ed32a393c9fe1089f10fee94&id=820efce641&e=659fba240e)to fully fund DHS and restore pay immediately. It is a commonsense solution to pay our homeland defenders, restore stability, and protect our national security.

**TODAY** \- this critical legislation will be voted on. Again, I will vote**YES** to fund the Department of Homeland Security and **END** this shutdown.

I’ve always opposed government shutdowns because they hurt working Americans and weaken our country. I won’t stop pushing until we get this across the finish line.

_**Because personnel and service members who work to protect America deserve better from Washington.**_

— Juan [**Click here**](https://juanciscomani.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4ed32a393c9fe1089f10fee94&id=d2cd92be9f&e=659fba240e)[**to**](https://juanciscomani.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4ed32a393c9fe1089f10fee94&id=23993197f1&e=659fba240e)[**read my op-ed.**](https://juanciscomani.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4ed32a393c9fe1089f10fee94&id=43761b4e4d&e=659fba240e)

name: Justin Riemer - RITE President
subject: RITE Files Supreme Court Brief Defending Arizona’s Proof of Citizenship Laws
body:
States should be able to enforce citizen-only voting |
---
| |
---
| | **RITE Files Supreme Court Brief Defending Arizona’s Proof of Citizenship Laws**
**WASHINGTON, D.C.** – Restoring Integrity and Trust in Elections (RITE), joined by the Center for Election Confidence and the Honest Elections Project, has filed an [amicus brief](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=6a09a74775&e=ea91f782ea) urging the U.S. Supreme Court to review and reverse a Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals decision limiting states’ ability to enforce election integrity measures, especially those that ensure citizen-only voting.

The case,_Republican National Committee v. Mi Familia Vota_ , concerns whether the National Voter Registration Act (NVRA) preempts Arizona laws requiring proof of citizenship to vote by mail and restricting the removal of noncitizen and other ineligible individuals from the voter rolls.

RITE argues that the Ninth Circuit badly misread the NVRA, which governs voter registration and list maintenance, but not the manner of voting. Their brief also warns that the decision could prevent states from effectively removing noncitizens and other ineligible voters from voter rolls. RITE’s brief supports the Republican National Committee’s and Arizona legislature’s petitions for writ of certiorari asking the Supreme Court to hear the case and reverse the Ninth Circuit’s ruling.

“As the dissenting judges recognized, the Ninth Circuit’s ruling was ‘profoundly wrong,’” said RITE President Justin Riemer. “We are proud to join HEP and CEC in supporting efforts to ensure its reversal. States must be able to enact commonsense safeguards against noncitizen registration and voting.”

This is the second joint amicus brief RITE, HEP, and CEC have filed with the Supreme Court in this case. In 2024, we supported the RNC’s and Arizona legislature’s successful request that the Supreme Court stay parts of an earlier Ninth Circuit ruling. Our [amicus brief](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=73ea3f89e7&e=ea91f782ea) helped ensure parts of Arizona’s proof of citizenship requirements were in effect for the 2024 Election.

RITE continues to support litigation nationwide to ensure that election laws are applied as written and that states retain the authority to safeguard the integrity of their elections.
###

So, the establishment hopes silence will do their work for them. But movements don't grow because the media allows them to. They grow because citizens decide they matter.
That's where you come in.
Grassroots support is how campaigns like ours breakthrough media blackouts, reach voters directly, and challenge a political machine built on insider money.
Every contribution helps carry this message further and proves that citizens -- not gatekeepers -- still decide the future of this country.
If you believe it's time for leaders who will stand firm, speak plainly, and put America first without apology, now is the moment to step forward.
Help break the silence.

| Peter,

Lately, something’s been sticking with me on the campaign trail.

After events, I’ll talk with dads and their sons. Sometimes it’s a quick handshake and a few words. Other times, they stick around a little longer. And you can tell, they’re carrying a lot from trying to set an example to making sure their kids have more than they did.

I saw it growing up, too.

My dad worked in agriculture before finding his way into music. It wasn’t easy, but I never saw him complain. He just showed up every day and did what he had to do to support our family. It’s that kind of hard work and clear-eyed purpose that stays with you.

Now, I see that same quiet pressure in so many families across South Texas. And every day it’s getting harder to keep up the pace. Costs are up, opportunities feel tighter. And too often, the people making decisions in Washington don’t see any of it.

It’s why I’m running for Congress: to make sure that the families I meet every day on the campaign trail finally get their fair share.

Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

It wasn't easy telling the world I grew up dirt poor, I was raised by my Mamaw while my mother struggled with addiction.
It wasn't exactly the prep school/trust fund/summer-in-the-Hamptons upbringing that is commonplace in DC.
But I felt God called me to tell my story. Warts and all. I felt led to speak out because I believe millions of Americans share stories like mine. Stories of jobs being outsourced to China, addiction ravaging communities and killing our neighbors, and heeding the call of duty after the Towers fell on 9/11.
As your Vice President, I now stand in the breach for the left-behind, forgotten men and women who built this country, but were abandoned by the political class in DC.
I'll do everything in my power to make sure that never happens again. I'll fight every day for good folks like you.
I promise to always stand between you and the Democrat Machine that aims to obliterate everything that makes our country great.

Hi Peter,

Most families don’t get 100 days to figure out how they’re going to pay their bills. They get 30.

That’s why today, I’m introducing my 30-Day Plan: a transparent, concrete agenda for what I will accomplish in my first month as Governor of Wisconsin.

No vague promises. No platitudes. Just results.

Here’s what’s on my agenda:
* **Repeal Act 10** in order to restore collective bargaining rights for all Wisconsin workers
* **Close the special education funding gap** so school districts aren't forced to cut programs and lay off teachers to make up the difference
* **Pass universal Pre-K and childcare** utilizing the existing providers already serving Wisconsin families
* **Open BadgerCare as a public health option** for every Wisconsin family
* **Strengthen and fund domestic violence prevention and crisis support** across rural and urban Wisconsin

The Supreme Court just heard arguments in Watson v. RNC, a case that could invalidate laws in 30 states which allow for counting ballots that are postmarked by Election Day but received later.
And the Court's six conservative justices seem ready to rubber stamp one of Donald Trump's signature anti-voting priorities just months ahead of the midterm elections:

This is about chipping away at the right to vote, dismantling our constitutional rights bit by bit until voting is once again reserved only for the privileged few.
Republicans will not settle for this one victory against mail-in ballot deadlines. They have their sights set on bigger targets: banning early voting, outlawing absentee voting, and implementing a strict federal voter ID law that would disenfranchise millions overnight.
As the Supreme Court and the Trump Administration make voting harder, we have to fight even harder to win the redistricting war to overcome the hurdles MAGA is putting up to stop people from voting them out of power.
Our ballot measure to redraw Colorado's congressional map would flip three GOP-held red seats in blue state Colorado. The stakes here are as high as they get. If MAGA can whittle away at voting rights piece by piece AND gerrymander the House to prevent Dems from taking control, we could potentially never retake power in Congress.

And the Court's six conservative justices seem ready to rubber stamp one of Donald Trump's signature anti-voting priorities just months ahead of the midterm elections: | == Peter, we won't sugarcoat this: this is a troubling sign for our democracy and for fairness in our elections. This isn't really about mail-in ballot deadlines, issues with the Postal Service, or some technical dispute between state law and federal law. This is about chipping away at the right to vote, dismantling our constitutional rights bit by bit until voting is once again reserved only for the privileged few. Republicans will not settle for this one victory against mail-in ballot deadlines. They have their sights set on bigger targets: banning early voting, outlawing absentee voting, and implementing a strict federal voter ID law that would disenfranchise millions overnight. As the Supreme Court and the Trump Administration make voting harder, we have to fight even harder to win the redistricting war to overcome the hurdles MAGA is putting up to stop people from voting them out of power. clean_body: Pushing marginalized families further behind | | | | | | Dear Peter, Every politician has something to say about the cost of living. Not one of them will say this: When someone is denied an abortion, the costs don't stop at the clinic door. They ripple outward—careers derailed, savings drained, debt accumulated. A single political decision can alter someone's financial future forever. | Abortion bans don't hit everyone the same way. They crush hardest the people already stretched thin: those with the least margin for error, the fewest options, and the most to lose. Denied care turns deadly, leaving families to grieve while the bills keep coming. Reproductive freedom is economic freedom. We're fighting with everything we have to make that a reality—but we can't do it alone. The opposition is well-funded and counting on people giving up. In solidarity, Nancy Northup President & CEO P.S. It’s Chris Murphy here. I’m reaching out to personally ask you to chip in $3 to support the YES campaign for redistricting in Virginia.
If you already understand why this is important, you can use this link to chip in: [**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_vafe_20260326_1**](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/41?c0=em_ms_vafe_20260326_1.wJwTIR&amount=3&refcode=20260326-392&t=4&akid=392%2E12592%2E7TwnlW)
Donald Trump and his allies are trying to rig the midterm elections before a single vote is cast. They want to lock in power by manipulating congressional maps so voters cannot hold them accountable.
Our plan to fight back now heads to one place: **Virginia.**
What Virginia voters decide on April 21 will have national consequences. By voting YES on the Fair Elections Amendment, Virginians can help ensure that congressional maps reflect the will of the people, not politicians trying to game the system.
I’ll be blunt: If voters want to put a check on Trump, we need to pass this redistricting amendment and take back Congress.
But we are up against a flood of dark money trying to confuse voters and block this amendment. Early voting is already underway, and the opposition is not slowing down.
We need as many people as possible pitching in to make sure voters hear the truth and turn out to vote YES.
[**Can you chip in $3 or whatever you can spare today to help Virginians for Fair Elections fight back and inform Virginian voters by April 21?**](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/41?c0=em_ms_vafe_20260326_1.wJwTIR&amount=3&refcode=20260326-392&t=5&akid=392%2E12592%2E7TwnlW)

This is an important way we can stop Trump’s power grab and preserve our democracy.
Thank you for being part of this fight.
Every best wish,
Chris Murphy
U.S. Senator, Connecticut

name: Autism Health
subject: The Autism Health Summit is Almost Here!
body:
** The 2026 Autism Health Summit is Almost Here!
------------------------------------------------------------

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JyPTtXfKYd8&mc_cid=a1eca57db7&mc_eid=UNIQID

April 24–26, 2026 | Legacy Center Resort & Spa | San Diego, California

The Autism Health Summit is just 4 weeks away, and we are excited to welcome our community for three powerful days of education, connection, and collaboration. As our flagship educational event, the Summit brings together leading voices in research, medicine, advocacy, and integrative health. This annual gathering is designed for parents, practitioners, researchers, and advocates seeking deeper insight into autism and neurological health from a whole-body, whole-family perspective.

We are honored to host an extraordinary lineup of speakers, including Aaron Siri, Del Bigtree, Dr. Toby Rogers, Dr. Sabine Hazan, Dr. Dayan Goodenowe, Ed Clay, and many more respected experts and thought leaders. Together, they will explore emerging research, clinical insights, environmental factors, and practical strategies that families and professionals can apply in real life. To view the full list of speakers and sessions, click HERE to see our agenda (https://track.pstmrk.it/3s/ahsconference.com%2Fagenda%2F/b43o/B0fEAQ/AQ/2d1c7633-1942-4785-8b85-a9e07e1249f6/2/czUPpIo4G7?mc_cid=a1eca57db7&mc_eid=UNIQID) .

See our PRESS RELEASE HERE (https://track.pstmrk.it/3s/autismhealth.com%2Fwp-content%2Fuploads%2F2026%2F03%2FAutism-Health-Press-Release.pdf/b43o/B0fEAQ/AQ/2d1c7633-1942-4785-8b85-a9e07e1249f6/3/WWcf5H9B0f?mc_cid=a1eca57db7&mc_eid=UNIQID) for more informaiton on our partnerships with CPI and Dr. Goodenowe.

To celebrate the final countdown, we are offering a special $50 discount on in-person tickets. Use promo code Autism50 at checkout.

We look forward to welcoming you to San Diego for an unforgettable weekend of education, empowerment, and community.
REGISTER HERE (https://ahsconference.com/pricing-table/?mc_cid=a1eca57db7&mc_eid=UNIQID)
https://ahsconference.com/?mc_cid=a1eca57db7&mc_eid=UNIQID

We are deeply grateful to our top sponsors for their continued support and leadership: Cellular Performance Institute (CPI), Dr. Goodenowe Enterprises, European Wellness, and Satellite Phone Store. Their commitment helps make this event possible and supports ongoing education and outreach within the autism community.

We also extend our sincere thanks to our Silver, Health, and Wellness Sponsors whose generosity and shared mission strengthen this work, including Functional Genomic Analysis, Neuro Needs, Microbiome Research Foundation, NutraMedix, Relax Saunas, MAHA Action, Best EMF Products, ARCC Center, Children's Health Defense, myMico Lab, Life Wave and Brain Tap, Daylight Computer Company, Weston A. Price Foundation, VibraTec Plates, Sun Power LED, Stalwart Law Group, DNA Academy, Function Medicine Georgia, Kadiant, Algonot, Informed Policy Advocates, Micronic Silver, SPELLERS, Spectrum Sciences LLC, The Wellness Blanket, Xlear, Vicar Venetia, Sabre Defense Team, Pur Health, LLC, Warrior Mom, Purium, C-Polar Technologies, OxyHealth, Solex AO Scan, Pulse PEMF, MAPS, PatchMD, CelWel, ReligenDX, Frequency+ Peptides, Mindset Kids, Mosaic Diagnostics, and Physicians for Informed Consent.
SPONSORSHIP REGISTRATION (https://ahsconference.com/sponsors/?mc_cid=a1eca57db7&mc_eid=UNIQID)

Join Us for Our Monthly Autism Support Group!
https://autismhealth.com/support/?mc_cid=a1eca57db7&mc_eid=UNIQID

We invite you to join our upcoming Autism Support Group on Wednesday, April 1, 2026 at 5:00 PM PST / 8:00 PM EST. This virtual gathering is a welcoming space for parents, caregivers, and individuals navigating autism and related neurological conditions to come together in community.

Our support group is designed to provide connection, encouragement, and shared learning. Whether you are just beginning your journey or have years of experience, this is a place to ask questions, share insights, and gain support from others who understand.

Register using the link below to receive access details.

We look forward to connecting with you.
REGISTER HERE (https://us06web.zoom.us/meeting/register/hMAFdOSASdqV-G25WcswRA?mc_cid=a1eca57db7&mc_eid=UNIQID#/registration)

About Autism Health Inc.
Autism Health is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization dedicated to educating individuals, families, and communities about autism spectrum disorder (ASD). Autism Health provides educational programs, workshops, events, research, and resources tailored to meet the diverse needs of those impacted by autism and other neurological disorders.
DONATE HERE (https://autismhealth.com/donations/?mc_cid=a1eca57db7&mc_eid=UNIQID)
Autism Health Inc. depends on generous donations from our community. Large or small, every donation gets us closer to achieving our goals. We are grateful for your assistance! For more information about Autism Health, visit www.AutismHealth.com

We are honored to host an extraordinary lineup of speakers, including Aaron Siri, Del Bigtree, Dr. Toby Rogers, Dr. Sabine Hazan, Dr. Dayan Goodenowe, Ed Clay, and many more respected experts and thought leaders. Together, they will explore emerging research, clinical insights, environmental factors, and practical strategies that families and professionals can apply in real life. | | | | | | **April Events in Our Community**

Friends,
This legislative session was chaotic. In an extra-short session, we missed many chances to improve Hoosier’s access to healthcare, housing and childcare. Despite all my work and your advocacy, the legislature passed bills that will hurt our most vulnerable community members. However, I continued to fight for Indianapolis every step of the way, co-sponsoring successful bills that will help lower utility costs, improve education about dementia and Alzheimer’s, and expand access to health insurance for disabled public safety employees.
Even though this was my last session, my work for Indianapolis is far from finished. My commitment to our city is stronger than ever, and this April, I’ll be around Indianapolis helping build the community through a series of events, including a town hall and a volunteer party, which will be a great place to learn how you can be involved this year. Check out the events below for more info!
I’m looking forward to seeing all of you around Indy this April, keeping up the hard work of building a stronger, bolder, and more welcoming city for everyone.
Andrea

body:
We can’t ignore what’s coming | [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/128118594/610302148/-1977837920?refcode=3.26.26_FightFasc&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83ODg3MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiODBjNjNjNS0zZDI5LWYxMTEtOWE0OC0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=AG_wKVpMK54flQECWhGVrF6Y1qV9CbStjbvsx11zMso=&emci=7fb66d15-3029-f111-9a48-000d3a14b640&emdi=b80c63c5-3d29-f111-9a48-000d3a14b640&ceid=53531271)
---
Friend, **Republicans are using Tennessee as a laboratory for their most depraved ideas.** There is a concerted effort by Trump’s minions in our legislature to turn extremist rhetoric into real life policy, testing just how far they can roll back our rights, how much power they can consolidate for themselves and their billionaire buddies, and how far they can go without someone standing up to stop them. **Look what’s happening:**
* **Cruel and costly immigration enforcement** With legislation written by Stephen Miller, TN lawmakers would turn teachers, local officials, and even routine public servants into extensions of state surveillance and invasive federal overreach.
* **Civil rights are being ripped away** It seems like every time you turn around, TN republicans have introduced another bill designed to erode our cherished freedoms. From marriage equality, to the ability for women and families to make their own healthcare decisions, to our right to protest, rights many of us took for granted are under constant assault.
* **Transgender Tennesseans are being targeted** , with plans to create a database of our transgender friends and neighbors, exposing people’s private medical information under the guise of “transparency” and making these individuals targets for violence and hate.
* **Extreme abortion measures** are criminalizing women, including attempts to classify abortion as homicide, pushing the legal system toward grotesque outcomes that were unthinkable just a few years ago.
* **Public institutions are being dismantled** , with countless efforts to defund, weaken, demonize, and dismantle public schools through voucher scams. Effective public intuitions should be improved, not abandoned or privatized.
* **Cultivating hate** All of this is happening alongside the documented rise of extremist hate groups operating in TN, while the legislature habitually works to undermine the rights of peaceful demonstrators and grassroots groups working for equal rights.

**This is not abstract.** It is not hypothetical. **It is happening now** , and Tennessee is being used as a testing ground for the worst of what could come next across the country.

**Tennesseans are ready to fight back, and _t _hey deserve a candidate with a record they can trust:__**
* Fighting Trump’s wasteful National Guard deployment to Memphis
* Expanding healthcare access, including maternal health equity
* Leading public health efforts that protected vulnerable populations
* Securing real living wages for workers
* Defending your rights as Chief Public Defender
* Fighting for accessible transportation for working families
* Launching a free gun lock program that helped significantly reduce gun theft

**Safety, freedom, and opportunity are all connected and that you can’t protect one by sacrificing the others.**
This election is not just about who governs Tennessee. It’s about whether we lose our great state to a spiral of division, paranoia, and authoritarianism, or whether we change course and work toward something better. **What happens here will not stay here.** The whole country is counting on us whether they know it or not and we can't afford to sit this one out. That’s why I knew I had to run**. Tennessee is the frontline in the fight against fascism,** That’s why this governor’s race is so important. It is our clearest, most immediate, and maybe our last best chance we have to fight back, and win.

_**[Now is the moment to act. To organize. To get involved and do your part in whatever way you can. I’m ready to put in the work that its going to take to win this race. Are you ready to stand with us?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/128118596/610302150/1843264678?refcode=3.26.26_FightFasc&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83ODg3MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiODBjNjNjNS0zZDI5LWYxMTEtOWE0OC0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=AG_wKVpMK54flQECWhGVrF6Y1qV9CbStjbvsx11zMso=)**_ _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | [DONATE $10](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/128118598/610302153/1755811102?amount=10&express_lane=true&refcode=3.26.26_FightFasc&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83ODg3MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiODBjNjNjNS0zZDI5LWYxMTEtOWE0OC0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=AG_wKVpMK54flQECWhGVrF6Y1qV9CbStjbvsx11zMso=)

clean_body: We can’t ignore what’s coming | Friend, Republicans are using Tennessee as a laboratory for their most depraved ideas. There is a concerted effort by Trump’s minions in our legislature to turn extremist rhetoric into real life policy, testing just how far they can roll back our rights, how much power they can consolidate for themselves and their billionaire buddies, and how far they can go without someone standing up to stop them. Look what’s happening: Cruel and costly immigration enforcement With legislation written by Stephen Miller, TN lawmakers would turn teachers, local officials, and even routine public servants into extensions of state surveillance and invasive federal overreach. Civil rights are being ripped away It seems like every time you turn around, TN republicans have introduced another bill designed to erode our cherished freedoms. From marriage equality, to the ability for women and families to make their own healthcare decisions, to our right to protest, rights many of us took for granted are under constant assault. Transgender Tennesseans are being targeted , with plans to create a database of our transgender friends and neighbors, exposing people’s private medical information under the guise of “transparency” and making these individuals targets for violence and hate. Extreme abortion measures are criminalizing women, including attempts to classify abortion as homicide, pushing the legal system toward grotesque outcomes that were unthinkable just a few years ago. Public institutions are being dismantled , with countless efforts to defund, weaken, demonize, and dismantle public schools through voucher scams. Effective public intuitions should be improved, not abandoned or privatized. Cultivating hate All of this is happening alongside the documented rise of extremist hate groups operating in TN, while the legislature habitually works to undermine the rights of peaceful demonstrators and grassroots groups working for equal rights. This is not abstract. It is not hypothetical. It is happening now , and Tennessee is being used as a testing ground for the worst of what could come next across the country. Tennesseans are ready to fight back, and t hey deserve a candidate with a record they can trust: Fighting Trump’s wasteful National Guard deployment to Memphis Expanding healthcare access, including maternal health equity Leading public health efforts that protected vulnerable populations Securing real living wages for workers Defending your rights as Chief Public Defender Fighting for accessible transportation for working families Launching a free gun lock program that helped significantly reduce gun theft Safety, freedom, and opportunity are all connected and that you can’t protect one by sacrificing the others. This election is not just about who governs Tennessee. It’s about whether we lose our great state to a spiral of division, paranoia, and authoritarianism, or whether we change course and work toward something better. What happens here will not stay here. The whole country is counting on us whether they know it or not and we can't afford to sit this one out. That’s why I knew I had to run. Tennessee is the frontline in the fight against fascism, That’s why this governor’s race is so important. subject: We can't ignore this case

body:
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Mother Jones: Republican Justices Appear Poised to Destroy What’s Left of the Voting Rights Act [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=032626_1&amount=25]
We'll hand this straight to Mother Jones, Team: " The Supreme Court, with its six-to-three Republican-appointed majority, appears ready to kneecap what remains of the Voting Rights Act’s protections for minority political representation. "
The descriptive language seems harsh, but the objective of these justices seems clear -- a complete dismantling of our seminal civil rights law . We've said it before and will say it again, but it's been clear long before the MAGA movement that Chief Justice Roberts has seen the removal of the VRA as one of his top goals for his time on the Court. It appears he may be on the cusp of succeeding.
During recent oral arguments in Louisiana v. Callais , at least five conservative justices seemed ready to handicap the VRA so that it will no longer stop white majorities from locking racial minorities out of elected office through racial gerrymandering.
The consequences are simple to understand and grave for voter participation. The harder we make it to vote, the more politicians make voter participation feel worthless, the less people actually take part. Needless to say, the less people who participate, the less our democracy and our government looks like the people it's supposed to represent.
Team: We have to spread the word about this case and the consequences of dismantling the Voting Rights Act. Fuel our work with $35 or whatever you can today and help us defend the right to vote >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=032626_1&amount=35]

At issue in the case is Section 2 of the VRA, which requires that racial minorities have an equal opportunity to meaningfully participate in the electoral process. This provision has been used to strike down redistricting schemes and maps that prevented Black voters and other racial minorities from electing their preferred representatives. Since 1965, Section 2 has given people of color a seat at the table, from school boards to the halls of Congress. It appears this 60-year era is coming to an end.
“ Race is a part of redistricting always ,” Justice Sonia Sotomayor said, addressing the solicitor general from Louisiana, who was arguing against an existing map that had enabled the election of two Black members of Congress in his state. “ What you’re saying to us [is]...‘You can use [race] to help yourself achieve goals that reduce particular groups’ electoral participation, but you can’t use it to remedy that situation .’”
Striking down the last remnants of the Voting Rights Act is exactly why the Supreme Court held this case over from last year. Gutting Section 2 would take us backwards in time and allow racial gerrymandering to be a standard practice, silencing more voters. Just like the redistricting fights across the country, this is all about whether the party in power can choose their voters in order to stay in power in perpetuity.
We simply can't afford to go backwards like this. Will you chip in with $35 or more to help us fight back against these partisan efforts to silence voters? >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=032626_1&amount=35]

" The descriptive language seems harsh, but the objective of these justices seems clear -- a complete dismantling of our seminal civil rights law . We've said it before and will say it again, but it's been clear long before the MAGA movement that Chief Justice Roberts has seen the removal of the VRA as one of his top goals for his time on the Court. It appears he may be on the cusp of succeeding. During recent oral arguments in Louisiana v. Callais , at least five conservative justices seemed ready to handicap the VRA so that it will no longer stop white majorities from locking racial minorities out of elected office through racial gerrymandering. The consequences are simple to understand and grave for voter participation. The harder we make it to vote, the more politicians make voter participation feel worthless, the less people actually take part. Needless to say, the less people who participate, the less our democracy and our government looks like the people it's supposed to represent. Team: We have to spread the word about this case and the consequences of dismantling the Voting Rights Act. This provision has been used to strike down redistricting schemes and maps that prevented Black voters and other racial minorities from electing their preferred representatives. Since 1965, Section 2 has given people of color a seat at the table, from school boards to the halls of Congress. It appears this 60-year era is coming to an end. “ Race is a part of redistricting always ,” Justice Sonia Sotomayor said, addressing the solicitor general from Louisiana, who was arguing against an existing map that had enabled the election of two Black members of Congress in his state. “ What you’re saying to us [is]...‘You can use [race] to help yourself achieve goals that reduce particular groups’ electoral participation, but you can’t use it to remedy that situation .’” Striking down the last remnants of the Voting Rights Act is exactly why the Supreme Court held this case over from last year. Gutting Section 2 would take us backwards in time and allow racial gerrymandering to be a standard practice, silencing more voters. Just like the redistricting fights across the country, this is all about whether the party in power can choose their voters in order to stay in power in perpetuity. Hi friend, it's Deb Haaland. You know that I'm running for governor of New Mexico to deliver progress for working families. **But did you also know that I love to cook?
**
One of my _favorite_ New Mexican staples to make is green chile salsa. The taste of fresh tomatoes and local green chile always brings me back home — to my family, our traditions, and the values that shaped me.

I love this recipe so much, in fact, it inspired me to start my very own salsa company to support my family. From finding capital to get started, to overseeing the work in the commercial kitchen, to delivering jars of salsa to mom and pop shops in Los Lunas, Belen, Bernalillo, and more — I was a part of every step, knowing I was supporting my child, contributing to our local economy, and bringing Pueblo culture into grocery stores across the state.
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/7182?refcode=jtk298-fr-nd&t=2&akid=8522%2E400544%2EmRK10p)
Food brings communities and people together, Friend. When we share a home-cooked meal or baked goods, we share our traditions, our stories, and the care and time it takes to nourish our families. During this campaign, I've traveled across the state, meeting New Mexican families from all walks of life, breaking bread and sharing my vision for New Mexico.

I've shared my own struggles and listened to theirs. Together, we’ve made exciting plans for the future of New Mexico. I know New Mexicans want a governor who will fight for affordable healthcare, expand child care, make our communities safer, strengthen our schools, and protect our environment.
**That’s the kind of governor I will be.**
**I am ready on day one to get to work and deliver progress for our communities, including making it easier for local neighborhood markets to open and for grocery stores to carry home-grown food, especially to eliminate food deserts across New Mexico.**

My name is Adam Schwarze. I’m a former Navy SEAL who would spill my blood for this country without hesitation—and I’d do it in a heartbeat to defend the freedoms enshrined in our Constitution.

I’m running for U.S. Senate in Minnesota because the Democrats lining up for what they believe will be a political coronation aren’t just a wrong fit for the job — _**they’re completely detached from reality.**_

The frontrunner,**_Lieutenant Governor Peggy Flanagan, is actually radical._** And Rep. Angie Craig—the one desperately trying to catch her on the left—is a political weathervane who flips whichever way the radical winds blow, with zero regard for principle or the people she claims to serve.

_**Here’s the latest jaw-dropping example:**_

_**Just last year, Rep. Angie Craig voted for the Laken Riley Act—a commonsense bill that told ICE to actually deport illegal migrants with criminal records**. _

Fast-forward to today, and she’s now publicly regretting that vote, whining that giving ICE any new tools under this administration was a “mistake.”

Let that sink in.

**A young woman named Laken Riley was brutally murdered by an illegal immigrant. Congress passed a bill named after her to stop exactly that kind of tragedy. Angie Craig voted yes... and now she’s sorry.**

What a pathetic flip-flop. Another Democrat selling out American safety for left-wing applause.

I’ve never met a Navy SEAL—active or retired—who would ever dream of selling out this country. Not once.

My name is Adam Schwarze. I’m a former Navy SEAL who would spill my blood for this country without hesitation—and I’d do it in a heartbeat to defend the freedoms enshrined in our Constitution. I’m running for U.S. Senate in Minnesota because the Democrats lining up for what they believe will be a political coronation aren’t just a wrong fit for the job — they’re completely detached from reality. The frontrunner,Lieutenant Governor Peggy Flanagan, is actually radical. And Rep. Angie Craig—the one desperately trying to catch her on the left—is a political weathervane who flips whichever way the radical winds blow, with zero regard for principle or the people she claims to serve. Fast-forward to today, and she’s now publicly regretting that vote, whining that giving ICE any new tools under this administration was a “mistake.” Let that sink in. A young woman named Laken Riley was brutally murdered by an illegal immigrant. Congress passed a bill named after her to stop exactly that kind of tragedy. Angie Craig voted yes... and now she’s sorry. What a pathetic flip-flop. Another Democrat selling out American safety for left-wing applause. I’ve never met a Navy SEAL—active or retired—who would ever dream of selling out this country. Not once. is me, fomer Navy SEAL Adam Schwarze. Not detached from reality. clean_body: Anyone who’s read the news this month can probably infer that Republicans are in serious trouble Anyone who’s read the news this month can probably infer that Republicans are in serious trouble | | | | | Fellow American, 🚨 OUR FUNDRAISING HAS HIT A SNAG 🚨 Can you spare $32, Fellow American? That 's our average donation in March so far -- and it's exactly what it will take to help us stay competitive and keep Texas red. Our fundraising has fallen off, and honestly, it's happening at a TERRIBLE time. We're preparing to report our 1st quarter fundraising numbers to the FEC, and we can't leave a single penny on the table. By now, you've probably heard: Republicans are in serious trouble here in Texas. Earlier this month, Democrats turned out in massive numbers, more than Republicans for the first time in recent memory, with over 2.3 million casting ballots in their Senate primary. Radical James Talarico emerged as their nominee, fresh off raising millions in record time, and national Democrats are already pouring in cash to make him competitive and flip the Lone Star State blue. They want to erase everything we've built here and end our 32-year winning streak for the first time since 1994. We cannot let that happen. So far this month, 430 conservatives have chipped in, averaging $32 each. It's not going to be enough to help us finish out the first quarter. That's why I'm imploring you to help me today. If we don't remain competitive, it could be the end of the line for Republicans in Texas. Can you make a $32 contribution right now? It would mean so much to us. Fellow American, I don't want to fight alone. If it's been a while since you've donated, I understand. But if you still believe in what we've fought for -- secure borders, tax relief, strong judges, and keeping Texas red -- I'm asking you to show up today. Your $32 will enable me to keep fighting for Texas values while pushing back against the radical left. Your name on our donor list shows we're not fighting alone. Thousands of grassroots donors pledging our average March donation sends a powerful message:Conservative Republicans are energized and unshaken -- and we will not let our streak end. I'm in this fight to keep Texas red and bring common sense back to Washington. Please stand with me in this critical moment. | | Friend, I’m bringing Sarah Explains It All to your inbox! In this series, I’ll break down some headlines coming out of D.C. and explain how they actually affect you. **Today, I want to talk to you about the SAVE Act and why I voted no _twice_ on this harmful bill.** I believe in a government that solves problems. A government that honors the fundamental principle our founding fathers fought for: the right to participate in free and fair elections. **A government by the people, for the people.** But the SAVE Act undermines that. While its supporters call the SAVE Act a win for election integrity, the reality is more concerning. **This legislation would require all American citizens registering to vote or updating their registration to present proof of citizenship, like a passport or birth certificate, in person.** We’d no longer be able to use REAL IDs or register to vote online, and we'd face new obstacles to mail-in voting. This is a huge barrier for so many Marylanders:
* Many **married and divorced women** would face a maze of bureaucracy—according to the Pew Research Center, approximately 84% of women who marry change their name, and would not be able to use their birth certificate to prove citizenship.
* **Low-Income voters** may lack the $165 for a passport or the means to travel in person to government offices to secure their personal records.
* **Military families** who move frequently would be forced to navigate strict paperwork hurdles every time they re-register in a new state.
* **Seniors** may not have those documents readily available or may have had their original documents damaged or lost over time.

I’ve always believed in solving real problems, but this bill is a solution in search of one. Non-citizen voting is already illegal. This isn’t about election security; it’s about making it harder for our neighbors to be heard. In this series, I’ll break down some headlines coming out of D.C. and explain how they actually affect you. Today, I want to talk to you about the SAVE Act and why I voted no twice on this harmful bill. I believe in a government that solves problems. A government that honors the fundamental principle our founding fathers fought for: the right to participate in free and fair elections. A government by the people, for the people. But the SAVE Act undermines that. While its supporters call the SAVE Act a win for election integrity, the reality is more concerning. This legislation would require all American citizens registering to vote or updating their registration to present proof of citizenship, like a passport or birth certificate, in person. We’d no longer be able to use REAL IDs or register to vote online, and we'd face new obstacles to mail-in voting. This is a huge barrier for so many Marylanders: Many married and divorced women would face a maze of bureaucracy—according to the Pew Research Center, approximately 84% of women who marry change their name, and would not be able to use their birth certificate to prove citizenship. Low-Income voters may lack the $165 for a passport or the means to travel in person to government offices to secure their personal records. Military families who move frequently would be forced to navigate strict paperwork hurdles every time they re-register in a new state. Seniors may not have those documents readily available or may have had their original documents damaged or lost over time. I’ve always believed in solving real problems, but this bill is a solution in search of one. Non-citizen voting is already illegal. If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue, your donation will go through immediately: | = = = = Hey Peter — it's Wendy Davis. I'm the newest member of the EMILYs List board of directors, but EMILYs List has been part of my story for a long time. I've been on the receiving end of early support from this organization, and I've seen up close what it can do for a candidate who's willing to run hard in a tough race. That's why I'm reaching out with just a week left in EMILYs List's big 3X match campaign. Here's the deal, plain and simple: every online gift through March 31 will be tripled — until we reach $500,000 and unlock $1,500,000 total to support women running in key races in 2026. = = As a Texan, I know how tough the fight can be when the other side has the lion's share of power and money, and will do absolutely anything to keep it. You don't win those fights by waiting. You win them by building early — by investing before anyone else thinks a race is winnable. That's what EMILYs List does. We back the toughest races of the cycle. And yes, that includes races in my beloved home state, where we're supporting leaders who are ready to fight and win — like my friend Gina Hinojosa in her campaign for governor. But this match only reaches its full impact if thousands of grassroots supporters step up before the deadline. subject: Nancy Pelosi showed up when it mattered
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
I want to tell you about a time Nancy Pelosi showed up for young folks.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260326-1&t=1&akid=3288%2E587540%2EHyePrV)
Peter,
Before Women’s History Month ends, I want to talk about another inspiring leader:
**Nancy Pelosi** is a legendary politician — the first woman Speaker of the House, one of the people most responsible for passing the Affordable Care Act, the leader who stood up to Donald Trump multiple times and _actually won_ fights that mattered.
Today I want to tell a story about a time Nancy Pelosi showed up for young folks.
After Parkland, my classmates and I didn’t trust politicians. **We were failed by the status quo — and we were tired of hearing the same tired excuses for inaction.** These are the same adults we felt were responsible for the weak gun laws that enabled the 19-year-old shooter who killed our administrators and classmates to be able to own an AR-15, despite repeated threats to shoot up our high school.
Nancy Pelosi was one of those politicians we were cautious about. But she still showed up anyway. I remember at a March for Our Lives event in 2018, we made a strict rule that no politicians would be able to speak. She came anyway, wearing a hat and sunglasses that she only briefly removed to show she was there with us.
In 2022, after the Uvalde and Buffalo shootings, March for Our Lives wanted to host a second march on the National Mall in front of the White House. The permit usually takes months to get approved — but I saw Speaker Pelosi at a protest and asked for her help. Along with Secretary Deb Haaland, she cut the red tape and made that second march on Washington possible. We were extremely grateful.
I have publicly disagreed with Speaker Pelosi. I have even protested in front of her office. But she has never once stopped showing up for survivors of gun violence.
[](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260326_1_whm.c_COFg&refcode=em20260326-3288&t=2&akid=3288%2E587540%2EHyePrV)_With Speaker Pelosi after the passage of the first gun law in 30 years._
**I’ve said it before, but I want to thank Nancy Pelosi for proving me wrong.** Thank you for showing us that politicians can sometimes do the right thing.
Thank you for your leadership over the years that has moved our country forward. And thank you for making room for the next generation of progressives to lead.
**[Peter, the next Nancy Pelosi is out there and Leaders We Deserve is going to help elect her. Will you contribute $5 right now to support our mission?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260326_1_whm.c_COFg&refcode=em20260326-3288&amount=5&t=3&akid=3288%2E587540%2EHyePrV)**

Thank you,
David Hogg

---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
| | Hi friends,
Listen to the Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.joinrmv.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.joinrmv.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.joinrmv.). And also, check out our [deep-dive video of the day](https://link.email.joinrmv.) on how Colorado's overdose death rates are rising, rather than falling as they are nationally.
Here is a summary of today's top stories:
🏛️ **Under the Golden Dome...** Lawmakers [rejected a proposal to increase transparency in wolf reintroduction](https://link.email.joinrmv.) spending even as the state seeks an additional $450,000 amid a $1.5 billion budget shortfall, while opioid deaths in Colorado continue rising—up 17% since late 2024—despite national declines, fueling [debate over drug policy](https://link.email.joinrmv.). Lawmakers are also advancing House Bill 26-1322, which would [expand civil liability for certain gender-related therapy practices](https://link.email.joinrmv.) as legal challenges to existing laws continue.

🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** A former Jefferson County educator claims she was [made a “scapegoat”](https://link.email.joinrmv.) after her ex-boyfriend’s arrest on child sex charges, while [drought conditions](https://link.email.joinrmv.) are prompting conservation warnings in Douglas County, where more than 85% of residents are affected. In Lakewood, voters will decide April 7 whether to keep or repeal [controversial rezoning changes](https://link.email.joinrmv.) after months of debate.
🇺🇸**On the National Stage...** A new poll shows [83% of voters support requiring ballots by Election Day](https://link.email.joinrmv.) as the Supreme Court considers related cases, while the Pentagon weighs [deploying 3,000 troops from the 82nd Airborne](https://link.email.joinrmv.) to the Middle East amid Iran tensions. Meanwhile, interest payments on the national debt have risen to about [15.5% of federal revenue](https://link.email.joinrmv.), highlighting growing fiscal pressure.
This is your Mountain Minute for Thursday, March 26, 2026.
– Team RMV
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Going the wrong way: Colorado’s fentanyl deaths rise while the rest of the nation falls](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
[](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
While much of the country is finally beginning to turn the corner on fentanyl, Colorado is heading in the opposite direction. And the human cost is staggering.
Colorado’s numbers are still moving up—synthetic opioid deaths have climbed 17 percent since December 2024. Elsewhere, the trend has started to turn. Across the country, overdose deaths have dropped 26.9 percent, according to the CDC, the steepest one-year decline of the crisis and the lowest levels since 2019.
Colorado isn’t just behind. It stands apart. A March 2026 report from the Common Sense Institute puts that gap into focus: 1,620 excess deaths.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
|
---
**[Colorado’s Ideological Regime Doubles Down](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** [FAIR COLORADO](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
* **Bill creates new legal risks for certain therapy practices:** House Bill 26-1322 would establish a new cause of action targeting “sexual orientation or gender identity change efforts,” allowing lawsuits with no statute of limitations, punitive damages, and expanded liability for therapists and related parties.
* **Measure follows legal scrutiny of existing state law:** The proposal comes after Supreme Court arguments in Chiles v. Salazar raised concerns that Colorado’s current conversion therapy ban may violate First Amendment protections by restricting certain viewpoints in counseling.
* **Debate centers on differing standards in counseling approaches:** The bill outlines protections for counseling that affirms gender identity while allowing legal action against practices aimed at alternative outcomes, highlighting ongoing disputes over how the state regulates therapy and professional speech.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
|

The only way we can continue to spread truth is with your support!
[DONATE TO ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
|
---
**[Colorado Wildlife Agency Seeks $450K More For Wolves Despite $1.5B State Budget Shortfall](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
* **State seeks $450,000 more for wolf reintroduction:** Colorado Parks and Wildlife is requesting $450,000 in general funds for 2026–27—about double last year’s spending—to bring in more wolves, despite not identifying a source for the animals.
* **Transparency proposal rejected by lawmakers:** Budget officials declined to create a separate line item to track wolf-related spending, leaving costs embedded in broader agency budgets and raising concerns about oversight.
* **Costs rising as survival rates and impacts draw scrutiny:** The program has already cost millions, with wolf survival rates below expectations and compensation payments to ranchers exceeding budgeted amounts, adding pressure as the state faces a $1.5 billion shortfall.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️ **
**[](https://link.email.joinrmv.)****[The Democrats who funded Colorado’s 611% Medicaid overrun are running for Congress](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
**[](https://link.email.joinrmv.)****BY JEN SCHUMANN | STATE | MARCH 24** _Colorado is staring down a $1 billion budget hole. Disabled kids are losing healthcare. Dental benefits are getting capped at $750 a year. Two Democrats who helped create and fund Cover All Coloradans are now asking voters to send them to Congress._
____
**[Colorado saw red flags in autism therapy billing and approved higher rates anyway](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** **BY JEN SCHUMANN | STATE | MARCH 23** _Every week, parents of autistic children in Colorado dropped their kids off with behavior therapists they trusted. What they didn’t know—what the state never required anyone to verify—was whether those therapists had passed a background check. Many hadn’t. Not because anyone failed a background check. Because Colorado never required one._
**[From party switch to $6.4 million: Examining the rise of a CD4 candidate](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** **BY JEN SCHUMANN | STATE | MARCH 20** _In a matter of months, Eileen Laubacher went from a newly registered Democrat with no primary voting history to the best-funded candidate in Colorado’s 4th Congressional District. That kind of political acceleration is unusual on its own. What makes it more striking is how many pieces had to move at once to get there._**[](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**__

As the 38th state, Colorado uniquely shares the year with America’s 250th birthday—creating a rare “twin anniversary,” sometimes called a sesquisemiquincentennial—and is the **only state to celebrate its 150th in the same year as the nation’s 250th**.

### A NEWSLETTER FROM REP. MANNY RUTINEL

| | |
### 75th Colorado General Assembly
---
| | | | | | | | | | |

|

| | | **Peter ,**
March is here, and we’re officially halfway through the legislative session!
It’s been a busy few months, and we’re moving forward on bills to expand housing access, protect worker safety, and strengthen public security. I’m excited to share what we’ve accomplished so far and what’s next.
Thank you for staying engaged and helping shape our work. Read on for updates and ways to stay involved!
And, as always, **please reply to this email with any ideas, concerns, or feedback you have for me!**

#### What have we been working on?
---
| |

#### I am excited to share the first bills I am proudly sponsoring this session regarding _Public Safety_ , _Housing,_ and _Workers Rights_. I welcome community feedback, concerns, and suggestions for how we can make these ideas work for the betterment of our community and all Coloradans.
---
|
---
| |
#### House Bill 26-1265, Law Enforcement National Electronic Tracing System & Share Program
---
| |
**Overview —**

This bill requires every law enforcement agency to register for and use the ATF’s electronic tracing system and submit identifying information for crime-related recovered firearms. It standardizes reporting and improves real-time collaboration so investigators can connect cases faster, solve more gun crimes, and keep communities safer.
---

---
| | [Reach Out With Feedback!](mailto:mannyforcolorado@gmail.com?subject=HB26-1265%20Feedback&body=)
---
|
---
| |
#### House Bill 26-1240, State Earned Income Tax Credit Removal of Age Limit
---
| | **Overview —**

This bill expands Colorado’s Earned Income Tax Credit to include eligible workers over 65 who are currently excluded. It removes an unfair age barrier, helping seniors make ends meet while boosting local economies.
---
| | | | | | | | | | | [Learn More About This Bill](https://mannyforcolorado.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=63143f582fd3822f96c2d5a0d&id=2f0c2489ad&e=7c6c4ab1eb)

| | [Reach Out With Feedback!](mailto:mannyforcolorado@gmail.com?subject=HB26-1240%20Feedback&body=)
---
|
---
| |
#### House Bill 26-1202, Strategy to Reduce & Prevent Homelessness
---
| |
#### Overview —

This bill requires a clear statewide homelessness strategy with timelines and costs. It also lets communities coordinate regionally and, with voter approval, fund homelessness response while giving counties more flexibility to support affordable housing.
---
| | | | | | | | | | | [Learn More About This Bill](https://mannyforcolorado.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=63143f582fd3822f96c2d5a0d&id=f34803b886&e=7c6c4ab1eb)

| | [Fast Action](https://mannyforcolorado.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=63143f582fd3822f96c2d5a0d&id=6ae4cc79b0&e=7c6c4ab1eb)
---
| | [Reach Out With Feedback!](mailto:mannyforcolorado@gmail.com?subject=HB26-1202%20Feedback&body=)
---
|
---
| |
#### House Bill 26-1127, Reporting After Fatal Car Crash
---
| |

#### Overview —

This bill requires coroners to include toxicology results for all deceased parties in required fatal crash reports. It fills key information gaps so investigations and prevention efforts are based on the full facts.
---
| | | | | | | | | | | [Learn More About This Bill](https://mannyforcolorado.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=63143f582fd3822f96c2d5a0d&id=69b627bd23&e=7c6c4ab1eb)

#### House Bill 26-1054, Protection for Worker Safety
---
| |

#### Overview —

This bill keeps Colorado workers safe on the job, even if federal standards are weakened, by requiring employers to follow recognized hazard protections and Colorado safety rules.

name: Usamah Andrabi
subject: My new op-ed in The Nation →
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Hey Peter, this is Usamah, Justice
Democrats’ Communications Director.

If we've talked in the last 5 years, you've heard me and the rest of Team
JD rail on AIPAC and its toxic influence on our elections. Our fight
against them is working: Democratic Congressmembers and candidates are
rejecting campaign checks from the right-wing megadonor-funded Israel
lobby group like never before.

Now, while that work continues, I want to sound the alarm on the next
AIPAC: the AI lobby.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260326.HaiqGm&refcode=em20260326-37604&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1002&akid=37604%2E1203867%2Ec_7cQj ]The Nation: AI is the New AIPAC. Companies like Anthropic are powering
a new election spending boom that's just as deceptive and destructive as
anything the pro-Israel lobby has done.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260326.HaiqGm&refcode=em20260326-37604&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1003&akid=37604%2E1203867%2Ec_7cQj ]I just wrote an op-ed for The Nation on why AI is the next AIPAC, and
why we need to come together to defeat the AI lobby’s PACs in this year’s
primary elections. If you’re already with me, will you pitch in
$5 now to help us?

The AI lobby has burst onto the scene by spending millions of dollars in
the 2026 primaries so far, including $3.5 million in Illinois and $1.6
million in North Carolina. And like AIPAC, it is largely doing so by using
opaquely named super PACs and flooding the airwaves with ads that don’t
mention AI at all.

While each corporation — from OpenAI to Meta to Anthropic — tries to
convince us they are the good ones, they are all opposing candidates
promising to take on the AI lobby like Justice Democrats Nida Allam in
North Carolina and Junaid Ahmed in Illinois.

They are turning our elections into a for-profit pissing match between Big
Tech billionaires.

Affordability and forever wars will be at the center of every election
this year, and the future of AI policy plays a central role in both of
these fights. At home, AI corporations are trying to evade responsibility
for the harm their data centers cause to communities across the country:
raising their utility bills, poisoning their air, and stealing their water
supply. Abroad, their technology is being used to power Trump’s war
machine and carry out war crimes, including the elementary school bombing
that killed over 100 children in Iran.

Like AIPAC and Crypto, AI super PACs are an existential threat to our
democracy, and we should all be united in opposition to their involvement
in our elections. These are right-wing lobbies, pushing right-wing
interests, to protect their own bottom lines, and they are doing so by
electing the weakest Democrats in the bluest seats.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260326.HaiqGm&refcode=em20260326-37604&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1004&akid=37604%2E1203867%2Ec_7cQj ]But with your support, we CAN stop them. Help us take on and beat the
AI lobby in our nine upcoming primary fights by making a grassroots
donation today →

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260326.HaiqGm&refcode=em20260326-37604&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1023&akid=37604%2E1203867%2Ec_7cQj ]Contribute $5

In solidarity,

Usamah Andrabi
Communications Director

Contribute to Justice Democrats: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20260326-37604-footer&t=1024&refcode2=37604_1203867_c_7cQj&akid=37604%2E1203867%2Ec_7cQj

name: Tom Fitton
subject: While we were at the Supreme Court...
body:
In all my years at Judicial Watch, I can’t recall a time that was busier or when the importance of our work was more evident and it’s your sustained support which makes our history making impact possible.

| | |
---
|
---
|
---
| Dear Fellow American,

In all my years at Judicial Watch, I can’t recall a time that was busier or when the importance of our work was more evident.
On Monday, we appeared before the Supreme Court of the United States, fighting to stop the illegal counting of ballots received after Election Day. We’re hoping the High Court will agree with our side which could halt the practice nationwide. It would be a generational victory for confidence in our elections.
I also have EVEN MORE BREAKING NEWS to report to you...
While we were in Court, Judicial Watch filed a _new lawsuit_ against the federal government for _gain-of-function (GOF) funding_ proposals prior to the COVID-19 pandemic.
As you know, _COVID-19 was also an election integrity crisis_ with many states using the pandemic as a reason to extend ballot counting after Election Day for weeks...
**We want to find out what the Deep State operatives knew....**
**And did our government help fund research which led to the pandemic?**

Our new lawsuit aims to find out and _[I’m asking for your support in our fight for the truth.](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=80443&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)_
| [HELP EXPOSE THE TRUTH ABOUT COVID-19](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=80443&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

****

We are using the Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) to seek records on GOF

**funding proposals** submitted to the **_Biological Technologies Office_** of the Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency (DARPA) **before December 2019**.

Senator Rand Paul has previously written that at least _15 federal agencies knew_ from the beginning of the pandemic that **EcoHealth Alliance** and the Chinese-based **Wuhan Institute of Virology** were seeking **federal funding** in 2018 to create **_a virus genetically similar if not identical to COVID-19._**

We have reason to believe GOF proposals were active in the Defense Department’s pipeline prior to the pandemic.

**Our lawsuit intends to find out what these proposals entailed.**

**Judicial Watch** has been a national leader in exposing government secrets about COVID-19 and _[with contributions from supporters like you, we won’t stop fighting until the whole truth is a matter of public record.](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=80443&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)_

Thank you for fighting for government transparency with Judicial Watch.

Tom Fitton
President, Judicial Watch
