Hi team,
It's opening day. We've got high hopes.
**The Phillies are going all the way,**_**and so are we.**_
We knocked petition season out of the park. We filed [nearly 4,000 signatures](https://open.substack.com/pub/wallaceforcongress/p/thank-you?utm_campaign=post-expanded-share&utm_medium=web), rivaling the number filed by a fourth-term incumbent, and we had over 130 volunteers.
We're covering all our bases. We're holding [town halls](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/1c8e76ab-f214-4605-83a3-938bb9f9baa3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), showing up to [community events](https://open.substack.com/pub/wallaceforcongress/p/mar-a-lago-vs-pa-09?utm_campaign=post-expanded-share&utm_medium=web), visiting [local unions](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/4c4a8584-5fc9-483d-b0fc-f347b5d83adf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and meeting people where they are in every corner of our district.
We crushed it in the preseason. Last quarter, our grassroots campaign [outraised Dan Meuser.](https://open.substack.com/pub/wallaceforcongress/p/our-grassroots-movement-beat-dan?utm_campaign=post-expanded-share&utm_medium=web) We beat his tens of thousands of dollars in PAC money with entirely individual contributions.
In 2026, we're bringing it home.
But we can't take our eye off the ball. Meuser's got a bench of big donors ready to swing. If we want to take this all the way to November, we need everyone to step up to the plate. I know we can do it.
**This is our year.**
**[Be a part of it. Chip in before our end-of-quarter deadline and join the winning team.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/23df77ce-d171-4525-9ec8-6bdfcff4291c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

- Rachel Wallace

Hi team,
If you run for Congress, you should expect to be held accountable for your actions. Our district deserves honest leaders who answer tough questions and who take responsibility for the decisions they make on behalf of our communities.
Right now, we’re not getting that from Jeff Hurd.
Hurd promised to look out for us. But once he got to Washington, he voted for a budget that would cut Medicaid in a district with the highest Medicaid enrollment in Colorado — putting rural hospitals, seniors, the disabled, and low-income families’ care at risk.
I've been traveling through all 27 counties of this district, hearing from voters about the challenges they’re facing and the leadership they expect.
Because the people of Southern and Western Colorado deserve leaders who show up, tell the truth, and fight for them.
If you believe it’s time for transparency, accountability, and independent leadership in CO-03, I’m asking you to stand with me in this campaign. Please give $10 or more today to help us continue organizing across our district and replace Hurd. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2603-q1-ak]

subject: Here’s what we’re up against
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Eric Burlison for Congress]()
body:
The NFA was never about safety. It was always about control.

| | | | | [|
---](https://ericburlisonforcongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b6500a115da3c4344522b1e48&id=68810612c5&e=5f9dc01b8c)
| | Peter ,

The people who oppose your Second Amendment rights don’t want this conversation happening at all.Here’s how Washington works when it comes to gun rights. Every time someone proposes protecting Second Amendment freedoms, the same playbook kicks in. The media calls it “dangerous.” The gun control lobby runs the same fear campaigns. And the establishment Republicans who talk a big game about the Second Amendment quietly let the bill die in committee.But consider what we’re actually talking about. The NFA was passed in 1934, before most of us were born, before the civil rights movement, before the federal government decided it had the authority to regulate nearly every aspect of American life. It was one of the first major federal gun control laws, and every restriction that came after it was built on its foundation.Repeal the NFA, and you don’t just restore rights for gun owners today. You pull the rug out from under decades of federal overreach.That’s why the opposition is going to be fierce. The ATF doesn’t want to lose its authority. The gun control groups don’t want to lose their framework. And the politicians who’ve spent careers “compromising” on your rights don’t want to admit they’ve been wrong.I didn’t come to Washington to go along and get along. I came to fight for the Constitution. Not backing down,

I just had to make a really tough call -- and you deserve to know about it.
My team just called me to go over our numbers. The bottom line? The GOP is spending $300 million to defend their trifecta and protect MAGA rule in Washington -- and that money is flooding into races like ours.
Here's what we decided: **if we want to fight back, we have to get our ads in front of more voters and supporters now. So I gave my team the green light to launch a major digital ad push.**
The money wasn't in the budget. But I took the leap anyway.
Why? Because I know what's at stake. This isn't just a House race - it's a fight over whether MAGA gets to keep its grip on power, unchecked, for years to come.
#### Now, we need to come up with $50,000 to close the gap in our budget, and I'm counting on this community to help me get it done.
**[We can make a difference together. Can you chip in anything to help us close the gap and keep these new ads running ahead of our ONLY FEC deadline?](https://substack.com/redirect/227eab50-40e6-4f1e-8bab-ae5a619b8268?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[ KEEP OUR ADS RUNNING](https://substack.com/redirect/227eab50-40e6-4f1e-8bab-ae5a619b8268?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Look, I don't make these kinds of budget decisions lightly. But my primary is just weeks away and we're running out of time to get our message out.
#### **The GOP is spreading misinformation 24/7, and ads like ours correct the record and lay out what 's at stake for voters.**
##### _Folks in Maryland 's 5th district deserve to know the truth about Trump's attacks on our democracy._
**[Your support today will help decide whether we can keep these ads live, or need to go dark. I'm hoping you'll step up with a contribution of any amount you can afford -- please click here to power our work:](https://substack.com/redirect/227eab50-40e6-4f1e-8bab-ae5a619b8268?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

Thanks for everything,
Harry

Leadership rooted in service and accountability; based in Montana values. | [](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=b2bc55c99cf3404295407af1ba54b8fc&_e=_PTPFbVn74Ik4LyBr5jYA3hyOGYRoC8-w5VVBha2lYXlljV2ulnhFUE5ivvelxT6YDG-3jj7JAaFMSyfD0UlIrz8ZOSmHxO-ABycx3PaXQsoGR6pq_FhS0I66PFuNKD0tX_qvvuhtJvaYEduqnYDRDDVgSstChDy9DKYdAkWryeEjr2yx3sU6oioOlOgDKaRKaHNu7xaJLNkwGvHtAEn7SxXCVbb_Imc7Doqm1Zd5Et9-CIPJlnLO3g_i-TqYN2uchNKWPPsZPZbrdFJh6vX19jeeQ3JLxphUZ_A-wHerAFofydcNDCyqtce_k9ZskvtjP-VwoGERhXDLOQhh3t223CXySH994j71ivavfX5m55fgBlb_oI8f5sfehU_kyr5lmpDHG8c1OwpTErZLE0EFDbveloIgy6KcPK04LSjwWme_dUG1rhNU_lhZSLD_i7O1OAAIctGguh0L26l6_7d8fG0UM9oLnLDUXvjzzIIkjy9bghjoTSTOhWfyuL8QzkPmPFnag-Ml_VlskW5RywxGAYLYQ4-3DRnf8lIzoy85l4UtPNV2GigwxK8YfSug556IFWlcqiFxwlMLyw16fl2CSDOcXv6TK55gDZzSFTRYxj-L86OfHje7OGdpceifQ7RPnbouWXm0LXFJANWd2eb7fpyfK3B6CFX05kJsJQK_Ag%3D)
---
I wanted to take a moment to introduce myself, Fellow Patriot.

My name is Kurt Alme, and I am running for U.S. Senate because I believe Montana deserves leadership rooted in service, accountability, and in the conservative values we were raised on.

I am a Montana native. I was born in Great Falls to two public school teachers who taught me from an early age that hard work, education, and giving back _**matter**_.

Growing up, I lived all across the state - Dillon, Victor, Helena, and Miles City - giving me a deep appreciation for our communities and the people who make Montana great.

[](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=b2bc55c99cf3404295407af1ba54b8fc&_e=_PTPFbVn74Ik4LyBr5jYA3hyOGYRoC8-w5VVBha2lYXlljV2ulnhFUE5ivvelxT6YDG-3jj7JAaFMSyfD0UlIrz8ZOSmHxO-ABycx3PaXQsoGR6pq_FhS0I66PFuNKD0tX_qvvuhtJvaYEduqnYDRDDVgSstChDy9DKYdAkWryeEjr2yx3sU6oioOlOgDKaRKaHNu7xaJLNkwGvHtAEn7SxXCVbb_Imc7Doqm1Zd5Eu1qwGUWQErE8MsoHnaNe1BnVL13yeAu-5MpmrNnC7qgyy231aUrmY1cff1oFHDy6hTzUlwU-MU3wlftdsohqXjxVDPpOdd1G0HNJCFbubQu2Bxav_RZVD6gSQs7UyqaVOPXESWwdF0rthqVPRjpu1OivZlsnMMy37CtGzR4bKdfLFo_sPNohcdXmnVD0nvnReZ0fhpDdkEdSh7rlAyY2EFwryZ3D2hn_OXbG6kwCM8pbjQFPqhS72rk0kpBNyDCxrxAGxNq5J8T9ksaGAYvWkYBA5S-uk2j7f0-JKkvLvNIlr_RWrW0eEKkv5sP7qXq-gEzFUMPWiUGvYQvcQb2nFproUCo__DKPuztAQ_1ASySC9a43_CorrDyNSRYVlza5EmWGuz0puN0Qs5jRSmbcXpDByP905ZXIN7FaLXWt1FogBhwZo9psP9tHE3RL6PjDY%3D)
I earned a business degree at the University of Colorado and a law degree at Harvard. But I always knew I would come home. _**And I did.**_

I came back to Montana to serve. First as a prosecutor, and then as Montana's U.S. Attorney, I fought fraud, violent crime and drug trafficking. As a Budget Director for Montana, I worked to balance the budget, cut taxes and keep government accountable. I've also helped lead many nonprofit organizations focused on caring for our youth, seniors, sick and mentally ill to strengthen our communities and serve Montana families. I've dedicated my life to service, and I am ready to keep serving our country.

clean_body: Leadership rooted in service and accountability; based in Montana values. | I wanted to take a moment to introduce myself, Fellow Patriot. My name is Kurt Alme, and I am running for U.S. Senate because I believe Montana deserves leadership rooted in service, accountability, and in the conservative values we were raised on. I am a Montana native. I was born in Great Falls to two public school teachers who taught me from an early age that hard work, education, and giving back matter. Growing up, I lived all across the state - Dillon, Victor, Helena, and Miles City - giving me a deep appreciation for our communities and the people who make Montana great. I earned a business degree at the University of Colorado and a law degree at Harvard. But I always knew I would come home. And I did. I came back to Montana to serve. First as a prosecutor, and then as Montana's U.S. Attorney, I fought fraud, violent crime and drug trafficking. As a Budget Director for Montana, I worked to balance the budget, cut taxes and keep government accountable. I've also helped lead many nonprofit organizations focused on caring for our youth, seniors, sick and mentally ill to strengthen our communities and serve Montana families. I've dedicated my life to service, and I am ready to keep serving our country. I've spent my career getting the job done - not chasing headlines. Now, I am running for U.S. Senate because I've seen firsthand the pressure Montana families are feeling - and Washington isn't working the way it should. I am not running for notoriety or to be part of the DC Swamp. I am running to represent the people I grew up with. I am running for people just like you. But, Fellow Patriot, I cannot do this alone. This campaign will be built the right way. It will be built with grassroots support from people who believe in our conservative values and believe in defending our Montana way of life. subject: I’m on the ground in Texas
body:
---
| [](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-march-2026?amount=20&refcode=em_20260326_6522_fr&refcode2=6522_22930333_A26jz9&akid=6522%2E22930333%2EA26jz9)
---
Derek,
I’m on the ground in Texas right now, and the energy is _electric_.
Just a few weeks ago, Texas voters chose James Talarico as their Democratic nominee for United States Senate.
James represents a new era of Texas politics, one based on hope and opportunity rather than fear and division. Where families can afford their lives, freedoms are guaranteed, and the American Dream is back in reach.
In stark contrast, the Republican candidates for Senate are continuing to bicker and offer no real vision for the people of the Lone Star State. Now, a new reality is sinking in for Republicans: We have a real shot at flipping Texas blue.
But here’s the thing — just because we have a shot at flipping Texas, that doesn’t mean it will be easy.
**Right now, Republicans have more cash in their war chest than we do.** To win here, we’re going to have to invest massive amounts of resources into registering voters, knocking doors, and getting Democrats’ message out to the people who need to hear it the most.
**That means we’re going to need all hands on deck.** We’ll need thousands of people to volunteer their time, and even more to chip in what they can to help us make sure those volunteers have the resources and supplies they’ll need on the ground.
[**Derek, if work like this is worth a few dollars to you, I’m asking you to chip in to the DNC today. We’ll put your donation to work immediately to elect Democrats in Texas and across the country in critical races like this one.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-march-2026?refcode=em_20260326_6522_fr&amount=7&refcode2=6522_22930333_A26jz9&akid=6522%2E22930333%2EA26jz9)
